market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver currently trades around $30-35/oz, and its all-time high is around $50. Reaching $120 would require a 4x rally within ~1.5 years, which is extremely unlikely absent hyperinflation or catastrophic supply disruption. The market-implied 6.7% probability significantly overestimates this event.
evidence_points: Silver’s nominal all-time high near $50 (1980), making $120 a >100% jump above any prior record.
Current silver futures active month settlement is around $30-35, requiring a 3-4× rally in 18 months.
No credible fundamental or macroeconomic scenario suggests such an extreme move by mid-2026.
